verdict_reason: The role and searchRole query parameters match the address-book controller, but the new AddressBookEntry type and its 'record' parameters blur the stored record and the write body.

todos.issue: One concept, two names that do not tell themselves apart: AddressBookRecord (line 11, the stored address with id, deleted, modifiedAt) and AddressBookEntry (line 27, the body a caller writes, with none of those). 'Entry' and 'Record' are synonyms, so neither name predicts which one carries an id. The parameters then cross them: createAddress(record: AddressBookEntry) (line 81) and updateAddress(addressId, record: AddressBookEntry) (line 95) name an Entry 'record'. The API itself calls this body AddressRequest (trade-imports-address-book AddressRequest.java:35).
todos.fix: Must: the writable body type has a name that says it is what a caller sends to create or replace an address, and the createAddress/updateAddress parameters are named for that type, not 'record'. One way: rename AddressBookEntry to AddressBookRequest (matching AddressRequest in the API) across the client, flows/shared/address-book-seed.ts and address-book-roles.spec.ts, and name the parameters 'request'.
